name: DuckDuckGo Images
author: Viboplr
description: Artist photos and album covers from DuckDuckGo image search, for the artists and albums the music catalogs don't know. Put it last in Settings → Providers. AI assistants can search web images too.

permissionReasons.network:duckduckgo.com: Search DuckDuckGo images for artist photos and album covers, and for an AI assistant's image searches

assistant.instructions: Web image search through DuckDuckGo (Bing's index). search_images is read-only. Results are whatever pictures sit near the words on the web: titles describe the PAGE, not always the image, and rights are unknown — so check a result is what you wanted (set thumbnails=true to look), credit the site, and set license=share (or stricter) for anything that will be shown or published. For artists, prefer a dedicated source first (commons__search_images for credited photos, deezer__search_art / itunes__search_album_art for official art) and use this when those come up empty. For a cue sheet, never use an image you have not checked against its title and page.

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search the web for images with DuckDuckGo. Returns up to `limit` images with url (full size, on the original site), width, height, title (of the page it came from), pageUrl, site, and thumbUrl when thumbnails=true. Stock-photo and social-media hosts are left out. Read-only.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'Portishead live 1998' or 'Dummy Portishead album cover'

layout.description: Image shape (default any). Album covers are square

minWidth.description: Skip images narrower than this many pixels (default 500)

thumbnails.description: Also return thumbUrl, a small preview of each image
